messages.subject: Error in ripple(cross, chr = 1, window = window, verbose = FALSE) :    could not find function "testchr"
parts:
Hi everyone,

I met this problem in the linkage-map construction. 

The error information is described as below. I tried to debug, updating the package, but it still doesn't work. Have you met this problem? Could you please help me to figure it out? 
I would appreciate your answer! 

 Error in ripple(cross, chr = 1, window = window, verbose = FALSE) : 
  could not find function "testchr" 
4  ripple(cross, chr = 1, window = window, verbose = FALSE) 
3  summary(ripple(cross, chr = 1, window = window, verbose = FALSE)) 
2  orderMarkers.sub(cross, i, window = window, use.ripple = use.ripple, 
    verbose = verbose.sub) 
1  orderMarkers(KNC, chr = 1, maxit = 1000, map.function = "kosambi", 
    sex.sp = F, verbose = T) 

Best,
Chen
